headlines.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
headlines.summary: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft, uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency…

concept.title: AI Agents
concept.body: An agent is a model given tools and a goal, allowed to take multiple steps on its own — searching, calling systems, and acting. Power rises, but so does the need for guardrails and oversight.
concept.takeaway: Deploy agents on bounded, reversible tasks first; require approval before anything costly or irreversible.
